short_bio: Producer who has led Marvel Studios and the Marvel Cinematic Universe since Iron Man.
biography:
Kevin Feige was born in Boston, studied at the University of Southern California and started as an assistant to the producer Lauren Shuler Donner. He worked on You’ve Got Mail (1998) and X-Men (2000).

He joined Marvel Studios in 2000 and produced Iron Man (2008), the first film of the Marvel Cinematic Universe. He was named president of the studio in 2007.

He oversaw the interlocking series of films that led to The Avengers (2012) and Avengers: Endgame (2019).
